faq.question: How do you vet the influencers on your platform?
faq.answer: Every creator goes through a rigorous multi-step verification process. We analyze audience authenticity, historical engagement rates, and require identity verification to ensure you only work with genuine professionals.

faq.question: Does InfluencerOS integrate with Shopify?
faq.answer: Yes! Our platform integrates seamlessly with Shopify, WooCommerce, and Magento to track direct sales conversions and automatically calculate accurate ROI for each creator.

faq.question: What happens if a creator misses a deadline?
faq.answer: Our escrow system protects your budget. If deliverables are not met according to the agreed-upon timeline and contract terms, funds are automatically returned to your brand wallet.

faq.question: Can I invite my existing roster of influencers?
faq.answer: Absolutely. You can import your current creators via CSV or private invite links, and manage them entirely within InfluencerOS for free.

faq.question: What is the typical onboarding time?
faq.answer: Most brands are fully set up and launching their first campaign within 24 hours. Our Enterprise plan includes a dedicated account manager who handles the entire onboarding process for you.
